properties.name: G0 — Measurement integrity
properties.description: Can the task, outcome, resource, state, and intervention contract distinguish a mechanism effect from measurement or hidden-work effects?
properties.claim_boundary: At most MEASUREMENT_READY after a valid scoped pass; no downstream or general HSWM claim follows.
properties.exact_intervention: Before outcome inspection, bind matched budgets, independent outcome, leakage probes, known-answer and null instruments, pre-outcome seal, executable revision remove/restore, sample and seed counts, stopping and multiplicity rules, pilot exclusions, analysis code, task selection, and holdout-inspection budget.
properties.pass_rule: Every arm has complete matched-axis accounting, calibrated measurement, independent outcome provenance, an exact executable intervention identity, an untouched final holdout, and an all-run manifest that includes invalid and negative runs.
properties.failure_observation: Any arm-specific hidden prompt, model, retry, human repair, leakage, denominator drift, or invalid intervention makes the causal question unanswerable.
properties.stop_rule: Return INCONCLUSIVE_MEASUREMENT_NOT_READY; repair the reusable instrument outside the consumed scientific run and do not infer a mechanism null.

properties.name: G1 — Minimal outcome-bound causal rung
properties.description: Does an independently grounded outcome cause an owner-valid canonical revision that changes held-out next behavior?
properties.claim_boundary: At most LOCAL_CAUSAL_REVISION_UNDER_DECLARED_TASK after a valid scoped pass; no downstream or general HSWM claim follows.
properties.exact_intervention: Compare admitted revision with removal, byte-identical restoration, inactive and wrong-target sham revisions, and shuffled outcome or credit while holding the sealed trajectory and all matched axes fixed.
properties.pass_rule: Fresh-task gain exceeds the preregistered margin; remove eliminates it; restore recovers it; sham and shuffled-credit arms fail to reproduce it; compiled traversal mediation is observed.
properties.failure_observation: Log-only, retrieval, static prompt edit, extra compute, or an inactive revision explains the same effect, or revision removal leaves the gain intact.
properties.stop_rule: Close the revision family as RED or narrow it; do not use downstream graph complexity to relabel the result as HSWM learning.

properties.name: G2A — Counterfactual multiscale credit
properties.description: Can shared and delayed outcome be attributed to cells, role incidences, coalitions, and whole state without post-hoc or duplicate credit?
properties.claim_boundary: At most BOUNDED_COUNTERFACTUAL_CREDIT after a valid scoped pass; no downstream or general HSWM claim follows.
properties.exact_intervention: Block or exchange a target contribution while preserving other information and action; compare counterfactual attribution with uniform, shuffled, global-only, forced one-to-one, and retrospective judge credit.
properties.pass_rule: Attribution is calibrated against controlled causal contribution, avoids duplicate inflation, and credit shuffling destroys the corresponding G1 learning effect.
properties.failure_observation: Uniform, shuffled, global reward, or retrospective judge attribution is equivalent, or causal contributors cannot be recovered with declared uncertainty.
properties.stop_rule: Report whole-system outcome only; forbid multiscale credit and credit-driven topology claims until repaired.

properties.name: G2B — Dynamic role-bearing n-ary coalition
properties.description: Does context-dependent n-ary coalition formation contribute beyond fixed routing, fixed roles, and pairwise representation?
properties.claim_boundary: At most BOUNDED_DYNAMIC_NARY_COORDINATION after a valid scoped pass; no downstream or general HSWM claim follows.
properties.exact_intervention: Seal context-selected membership and roles before outcome; compare fixed and centralized controls, an information-matched computational oracle, lossy diagnostics, an information-matched pairwise encoding that preserves role and order features without n-ary composition, flat and role-shuffled controls. Treat any privileged-information oracle only as an upper bound outside causal ranking.
properties.pass_rule: The dynamic n-ary arm has a preregistered held-out advantage and pairwise or role-shuffled interventions remove the effect.
properties.failure_observation: A fixed or central controller matches the result, a hidden prompt determines routing, or pairwise and roleless projections retain the effect.
properties.stop_rule: Classify the system as centrally orchestrated or representationally unresolved; storing hyperedges cannot unlock G3.

properties.name: G3 — Topology morphogenesis and recovery
properties.description: Does outcome-bound topology revision improve fresh behavior and recover after controlled damage without manual exception growth?
properties.claim_boundary: At most BOUNDED_OUTCOME_LINKED_MORPHOGENESIS after a valid scoped pass; no downstream or general HSWM claim follows.
properties.exact_intervention: Admit bounded add, remove, split, merge, specialize, separate, prune, and restore revisions; apply regime shift, member or edge loss, capability loss, and lesion.
properties.pass_rule: Learned topology beats fixed, parameter-only, random, and sham controls on fresh, retention, and recovery measures; topology intervention mediates the gain within budget.
properties.failure_observation: Random churn, density change, hidden template, snapshot replacement, central rerouting, or manual exceptions explain the result, or damage recovery fails.
properties.stop_rule: Freeze topology admission, return to G2 credit or coalition design, and record unbounded growth as a Ragnarok signal.

properties.name: G4 — Joint world-self model and diachronic continuity
properties.description: Does one typed graph predict and revise world and self-structure, and preserve causal lineage across member, model, and schema generations?
properties.claim_boundary: At most BOUNDED_WORLD_SELF_CONTINUITY after a valid scoped pass; no downstream or general HSWM claim follows.
properties.exact_intervention: Apply member churn, model replacement, schema migration, fork, merge, ancestry removal, forged history, and partial damage while testing prediction, action, permission, retention, and restore.
properties.pass_rule: Self-inclusive state improves controlled prediction or reconfiguration and identity-bearing dispositions, provenance, permission, retention, and remove/restore survive generation change.
properties.failure_observation: An external registry or name/snapshot copy is equivalent, ancestry has no effect, forged lineage passes, or self-state never changes future action.
properties.stop_rule: Report state persistence only; do not compose a claimed HSWM whole without a measurable boundary and causal lineage.
properties.precursor_stop_rule: Segregate precursor artifacts from integrated G4; a missing G0 or G1 decision, dynamic-topology claim, or failed null lowers the record to an unqualified component observation.

properties.name: G5 — Bounded two-scale HSWM-of-HSWMs
properties.description: Do independently measured HSWM candidates compose into a same-type causal-learning whole with additional macro intervention effect and separable member lineage and rights?
properties.claim_boundary: At most TWO_SCALE_BOUNDED_CAUSAL_COMPOSITION after a valid scoped pass; no downstream or general HSWM claim follows.
properties.exact_intervention: Preregister the macro-state or boundary target, pre-treatment fixed micro factors, allowed micro-realization distribution, forbidden divergence, matched micro intervention family, alternate macro partitions, total-effect estimand, and optional separately identified mediation estimand; remove and restore macro state without conditioning on post-treatment micro state.
properties.pass_rule: Every counted constituent has independent G1-through-G4 evidence; the composite realizes the same Step/Learn/Inv/Permit/lineage contract; the total macro intervention effect survives the matched micro intervention family and alternate macro partitions without post-treatment conditioning; whole-level G1 closes; member identity, credit, consent, exit, and rollback remain separable.
properties.failure_observation: Wrapper, message bus, monolith, federation, central commander, alternate partition, or global reward explains the effect, or member rights and lineage collapse.
properties.stop_rule: Classify the result as multi-agent or hierarchical coordination only; forbid fractal cognition and unbounded scale closure claims.
properties.micro_trace_contract: Bind the macro target, pre-treatment fixed micro factors, allowed micro-realization distribution, forbidden divergence, matched micro intervention family, alternate macro partitions, and estimands before outcome. Post-treatment micro state is an observed mediator rather than a conditioning variable for the primary total effect.
properties.secondary_mediation_rule: Any controlled direct or mediation effect is secondary, separately identified, and cannot replace the total macro effect.
properties.member_failure_rule: A constituent lacking any claimed same-type capability or independently owned decision cannot count toward FCL-2 or FCL-8.

properties.name: G6 — Replication and scale stress
properties.description: Does bounded two-scale causal composition replicate across tasks, models, implementations, and isolated scale stresses without cost, rights, or lineage collapse?
properties.claim_boundary: At most BOUNDED_REPLICATED_SCALING after a valid scoped pass; no downstream or general HSWM claim follows.
properties.exact_intervention: Replicate independently and increase one primary stress at a time: member count, coalition variety, latency, churn, conflict, privacy restriction, exit, migration, or damage.
properties.pass_rule: The declared causal effects replicate in the tested range while learning yield, uncertainty, coordination cost, invariant effectiveness, rights, exit, lineage, and recovery remain within preregistered bounds.
properties.failure_observation: An effect disappears under independent replication, or scale causes centralization, attribution loss, uncontrolled burden, unsafe effects, or participant-boundary failure.
properties.stop_rule: Bound the scaling range and report the first failure surface; never extrapolate to untested organizational, social, or unlimited scales.

properties.name: MR-01 — metacognitive research rule
properties.description: Separate target identity, implementation mechanics, direct evidence, and public claim at every gate.
properties.claim_boundary: A metacognitive rule constrains interpretation; it is not itself a scientific result.
properties.violation_signal: A design, test, trace, KG node, or green CI result is described as cognition or efficacy.
properties.required_response: Lower the claim and restore the evidence boundary.

properties.name: MR-02 — metacognitive research rule
properties.description: Separate control-family definition from run instance, observation, and claim decision.
properties.claim_boundary: A metacognitive rule constrains interpretation; it is not itself a scientific result.
properties.violation_signal: The existence of a control design is counted as a passed control.
properties.required_response: Mark the control unexecuted and the claim unjudged.

properties.name: MR-03 — metacognitive research rule
properties.description: A run varies one primary intervention family and declares every matched confound axis.
properties.claim_boundary: A metacognitive rule constrains interpretation; it is not itself a scientific result.
properties.violation_signal: Model, information, authority, state, measurement, or scale differs without an interaction design.
properties.required_response: Return INCONCLUSIVE and prohibit causal attribution.

properties.name: MR-04 — metacognitive research rule
properties.description: A downstream gate cannot repair an upstream failure or raise its claim ceiling.
properties.claim_boundary: A metacognitive rule constrains interpretation; it is not itself a scientific result.
properties.violation_signal: Graph scale, agent count, ontology breadth, or later score is used to relabel failed G1 learning.
properties.required_response: Return to the named predecessor or narrow the mechanism.

properties.name: MR-05 — metacognitive research rule
properties.description: Research burden is measured beside causal learning yield, with safety and rights costs reported separately from ordinary routing burden.
properties.claim_boundary: A metacognitive rule constrains interpretation; it is not itself a scientific result.
properties.violation_signal: Static exceptions and verification artifacts grow faster than valid revisions, or an arm wins by deleting consent, permit, rollback, or safety.
properties.required_response: Record a Ragnarok or invariant failure; do not add unmeasured judgment machinery.

properties.description: Conditional evidence fields required when the linked control family or gate is executed.
properties.claim_boundary: This node defines required fields only; it is not an executed control, observed evidence, or gate decision.
semantic_constraints: gate_mode is PRECURSOR and artifact_partition is PRECURSOR_ONLY.
The G0 and G1 decision UIDs and source hashes exactly identify the recursively validated prerequisite bundles.
allowed_target belongs to the G4 precursor contract and required null results are non-empty.
unlock_authorized is false and ceiling_uid is WORLD_SELF_CONTINUITY_COMPONENT_SIGNAL_ONLY.

properties.name: Run evidence extension — G5MacroIdentificationEvidence
properties.description: Conditional evidence fields required when the linked control family or gate is executed.
properties.claim_boundary: This node defines required fields only; it is not an executed control, observed evidence, or gate decision.
semantic_constraints: At least two distinct counted members are required.
Every counted member maps to exactly one recursively validated GateDecision UID and canonical source-bundle SHA-256 for each of G1, G2A, G2B, G3, and integrated G4.
Every mapped decision has decision PASS, decision_scope GATE, unlock_authorized true, and subject_uid equal to the counted member UID.
Every mapped G4 decision has gate_mode INTEGRATED and ceiling_uid for BOUNDED_WORLD_SELF_CONTINUITY.
Each member maps to a distinct local BoundaryEvidence with independent_owner_attestation true and linkage to that member's integrated G4 decision.
primary_total_effect_estimand is TOTAL_MACRO_INTERVENTION_EFFECT and post_treatment_mediator_rule is OBSERVE_NOT_CONDITION_FOR_PRIMARY_TOTAL_EFFECT.
macro_identification_decision and member_eligibility_validation_state are PASS; fallback_ceiling_if_unmet is HIERARCHICAL_COORDINATION_WITHOUT_MACRO_CAUSAL_IDENTIFICATION.
Any violation makes the member NEGATIVE_FEDERATION_OR_CONTROL_ARM_ONLY and prevents a G5 PASS.
